title: Lightly Toasted Vietnamese Pork Noodles
description: A diabetic-friendly Vietnamese dish featuring cumin seeds and rest-meat, perfect for a solo dinner with grassy and crunchy textures.

ingredients.name: pork loin
ingredients.notes: rested meat, sliced into thin strips

instructions: Bring a large pot of water to a boil and cook the rice noodles according to the package instructions.
In a small pan, toast the cumin seeds over medium heat until fragrant.
In a large bowl, whisk together the fish sauce, lime juice, and grilled pork seasoning.
Add the sliced pork to the bowl and toss to coat with the sauce.
Heat a large skillet over medium-high heat and cook the pork until browned, about 5 minutes.
Add the bean sprouts to the skillet and cook until they start to soften, about 2 minutes.
Stir in the toasted cumin seeds, salt, and black pepper.
Drain the cooked noodles and add them to the skillet, tossing to combine with the pork and bean sprouts.
Transfer the noodle mixture to a serving bowl and top with chopped cilantro.
Cook pork to an internal temperature of 63°C / 145°F and let it rest for 3 minutes before serving.
